title: 灰の聖域と、断罪の祝祭
author: 黒羽 レイ

en.title: Sanctuary of Ash and the Festival of Condemnation
en.premise: Memory is the sole fuel that drives the city. Kyle, a recovery agent, discovers a 'lost letter' in the waste district—a letter that the Management Bureau was supposed to have erased. The letter contains a cursed truth: the city's prosperity is built upon the exploitation of people's happiest memories. On the night of the festival, to reveal the truth, Kyle is forced to make a decision: to offer up his very existence as the price.

zh.title: 灰之圣域与断罪祭典
zh.premise: 记忆是驱动这座城市唯一的燃料。回收官凯尔在废弃区发现了一封本应被管理局抹除的“遗失信件”。信中记载着一个被诅咒的真相：城市的繁荣竟是建立在剥削人们最幸福的记忆之上。祭典之夜，为了揭露真相，凯尔被迫做出抉择——以他存在的本身作为代价。
